verdict.rationale: Airwallex documents corporate cards with custom spend limits, automatically applied spend rules, and approval routing for bills, which covers the card-limit and approval enforcement half of the story. Nothing in the evidence shows allocating budgets to teams or projects, or tying limits and approvals to such budgets. missing for 10: team/project budget allocation, linkage of card limits and approvals to allocated budgets, depth on how limits are configured and enforced, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance lead, I can allocate budgets to teams and projects and have card limits and approvals actually enforce them
